text: Boarding Flight 180 for a senior trip to Paris, high school student Alex Browning has [a premonition that the plane will explode|trigger|strange signs and visions]. His panic gets him, [a handful of classmates|who_suffers|teenagers and young adults] and a teacher thrown off just before it does. Then the survivors begin to die in sudden accidents, a mortician explains that [Death is reclaiming those who were meant to die|threat|death and fate], and Alex learns to [read the warning signs around him|rules|death sends warnings].
